boundary: customer-observed wall clock from initiating sandbox creation through a confirmed successful nonce command; environment preparation and cleanup excluded

metadata.http_connection_reuse_source: default benchmark transport with HTTP keep-alives enabled
metadata.cache_state_source: operator-declared; the harness does not clear or mutate host caches
metadata.percentile_method: nearest-rank; successful and failed observed latencies are summarized separately without trimming
metadata.latency_definition: scheduled arrival through verified result; includes client-side admission delay to avoid coordinated omission
metadata.service_latency_definition: request initiation through verified result; excludes client-side admission delay
metadata.command_success_definition: HTTP 200; started event; exact generated nonce on stdout; zero exit event; complete ordered stream
metadata.verification_definition: exact generated nonce through the complete ordered command stream
